scripts.lint: biome check . && node scripts/text-check.mjs && uv run --project packages/mkdocs ruff check packages/mkdocs
scripts.test: npm test --workspaces --if-present && uv run --project packages/mkdocs pytest packages/mkdocs
scripts.test:browser: npm run test:browser --workspaces --if-present && npm run docs && BUILDGUIDE_SITE=../../site npm run test:browser -w packages/core
scripts.dist: npm run dist --workspaces --if-present && uv build packages/mkdocs
